steps: Visit the Office or Sub-Office of the Department of Women and Child Development to obtain the application form or print it.
Fill in all mandatory fields, attach a passport-sized photograph, and attach copies of mandatory documents.
Submit the filled application form and documents to the Deputy Director or Child Development Project Officer.
Request a receipt or acknowledgment containing submission details and a unique identification number.
parsed.department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Puducherry
